gloss: to long for; to wait eagerly for

definitions.gloss: to long for; to wait eagerly for; to pine for
definitions.explanation: To wait for someone or something with intense longing and impatience. Stronger and more emotional than simply looking forward to something; often used of a loved one's return, a season, or a long-awaited day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれる。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children can hardly wait for the summer holidays.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ついに⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new game I had been waiting so eagerly for finally came out.

notes:
Ichidan: {待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれる, {待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれた. A compound of ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait) and {焦|こ}がれる (to yearn). The thing waited for takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Mostly in the forms {待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ and {待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれた (long-awaited, before a noun).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれた⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: the long-awaited day
- ⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれる: to long to meet again
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{待|ま}ち{焦|こ}がれる: to wait anxiously for someone's return

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{待|ま}ち{望|のぞ}む→待ち望む：32366_machinozomu⟧: to look forward to, to hope for (less emotional)
- ⟦{待|ま}ちわびる→待ちわびる：32463_machiwabiru⟧: to wait impatiently, tired of waiting
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみにする→楽しみにする：26825_tanoshiminisuru⟧: to look forward to (everyday)
